result:
I've updated the register for the round-4 repairs (BE-Z5 and FE-Z3). Ten DG6 rows changed, in their notes and evidence only; no row's status changed. All required checks pass, and the changes are left uncommitted.

**Rows changed**
- **REQ-S10-002** (F-DG6-300, F-DG6-280): the notes now describe what BE-Z5 ships for a reader without access to a sensitive benefit:
  - **Traceability and missing links:** the benefit's node, links and warning are left out.
  - **G6 readiness:** every reader sees the same neutral text, with no code, title or id.
  - **Reports and snapshots:** live reports and stored snapshots leave the restricted rows out when read, and the export is still refused.
  - **Impact preview:** the benefit is counted as hidden.
  - **Escalation:** the executive ask is titled by the corrective case's code, and a blocker status naming a case the caller cannot read is refused as if the id were unknown.
  - **Evidence:** the four new tests and the sweep, which makes 418 requests per reader. They fail before the fix (6 failed) and pass after it (10 files, 63 passed).
  - **Residuals written in, as BE-Z5 lists them:**
    - 71 GET operations the sweep cannot fill;
    - the search index is empty during the sweep;
    - records stored before the fix keep the benefit's title;
    - ids and codes remain on some records;
    - some counts are kept so verdicts stay truthful;
    - report totals have no "includes restricted records" label.
- **REQ-S15-007** (F-DG6-320, F-DG6-301): records the 16 new English and Arabic error texts and the extended catalogue test. The test fails 3 of 10 without the texts and passes after. I viewed the Arabic screenshot showing the heartbeat "Last error" text.
- **REQ-S17-001** (F-DG6-281): records the connector edit screen now showing "A transformation you cannot view · id". The unit test fails without the fix, the new end-to-end test passes in English and Arabic, and I viewed the English screenshot.
- **REQ-S12-019 and REQ-S20-022**: short paragraphs on the stale-data and missed-heartbeat texts, the two exception kinds F-DG6-320 names.
- **REQ-DLV-038, REQ-S15-011, REQ-S20-001, REQ-S20-012, REQ-S20-017**: bracketed corrections only. Findings these rows still called open (F-DG6-160, 220, 221, 222, 260, 261) are now marked closed by reviewers. The sentence "no full run yet" now points to the passing orchestrator run of the round-4 tree (`orchestrator-final-04fcf43`).

**Checks**
- `validate.mjs --register` passes for DG6, DG5 and DG4 (exit 0), both before and after my edit.
- The CSV parses with 412 rows of 19 columns, and an unedited base round-trips byte-identically.
- The diff against HEAD shows exactly the 10 rows above, all DG6.
- All 368 evidence paths in the changed rows exist.
- `git diff --stat` shows only `requirements.csv`; the handback is the only other new file.

**Gaps**
- **No full run yet:** the tree with BE-Z5 and FE-Z3 merged has had no full integration or end-to-end run. Every new paragraph says the binding evidence is your final verification and then review round 5. Two caveats on BE-Z5's own runs:
  - its 64-file run came before two small final edits, and 54 of those files were not re-run;
  - it did not run the full integration suite.
- **Still open:** F-DG6-280, 281, 300, 301 and 320 stay OPEN. I closed nothing.
- **Catalogue test:** it now finds error codes written out literally in the API's validation calls. A code passed in through a named constant is still missed, so the earlier gap is narrowed, not closed.
- **Not covered by tests:** no end-to-end test asserts the heartbeat or stale-data "Last error" text. The email error codes still show raw on the notification-channel screens.
- **Earlier-gate rows left alone:** the escalation, traceability and executive-ask wording appears only in DG4, DG5 and DG7 rows, which I didn't touch. I checked five of them closely and none is made untrue by BE-Z5.
- **Damaged assignment file:** it has two broken headings ("What to c## What to change" and a truncated "…ification" line). The meaning was clear from context, and the handback records it.

The handback, with each row's acceptance clause, test and passing log, is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-AN-Z3-transformation-analyst.md`.
